items.text: Ballroom A+B and Ballroom C: plenary, keynote and larger symposium sessions

items.text: Yangtze, Amazon, Seine, Ganges, Mekong and Nile

items.label: Banquet
items.text: Wed 16 Dec, 19:00. There is no poster session on Wednesday.

items.label: Lunch
items.text: Conference lunch buffet. Venue to be announced.

items.label: Meal coupons
items.text: Please bring your coupon to each lunch and to the Banquet.

items.label: Cloakroom
items.text: Baggage storage. Also the first-aid and lost-and-found point.

items.label: Presenters
items.text: Please check your slides with the student staff in your room before your session or during a coffee break.

items.label: My Agenda
items.text: Tap the star on any talk or poster to save it. Your list stays in this browser on this phone.

items.label: Best way to open
items.text: Scan the QR codes with your phone camera so the page opens in Safari or Chrome, not inside a chat app.

items.label: Feedback
items.text: A 5-minute anonymous survey opens on the last day.
